research_question: Can the frozen MG correction mechanism be evaluated against a defensible prospective independent outcome using a single AURA skill target without circularity or unsupported synthetic labels?
ground_truth_status: No real independent outcome cohort has been collected or verified. The repository still lacks a provenance-preserved, time-ordered, action-linked outcome set suitable for model comparison.

evaluation_population.required_population: Prospectively collected or provenance-verified real completed episodes with frozen pre-action state, paired predictions, and independently measured post-action skill outcome.
evaluation_population.note: Repeated scripted scenarios remain non-independent synthetic data and cannot be treated as the evaluation population.

methodology_status: AUDIT_REVISIONS_REQUIRED; artifact integrity and action-module checks pass, but the secure container backend is unavailable on the audit host and a valid container-backed evidence-to-outcome lifecycle remains unverified. Owner approval is pending.
blocking_issues: The audit host has no Docker CLI/runtime and no digest-pinned secure worker image configured; participant code cannot run in the required isolated backend.
A complete valid secure-container-backed baseline-to-follow-up-to-outcome lifecycle remains unverified.
Pilot-owner approval remains a separate pending human action.
recommended_next_step: Provision and verify the digest-pinned Docker worker on a supported runtime, execute secure isolation integration tests and valid evidence lifecycle integration tests, then seek explicit human pilot-owner approval. Keep collection and downstream phases blocked.
